settings.status: Exploratory protocol recorded before these fits with earlier USGS results already known
settings.tie_rule: Longest candidate within absolute tolerance of the minimum
settings.count_nb2_variance: mu + alpha*mu^2 with exact Poisson alpha=0

optimizer.selection: Minimum training negative log likelihood over successful and exact nested candidates

settings.prediction: Unrounded conditional means and count PMFs with fitted parameters held fixed

count_pmf.scoring: Unnormalized direct PMF on integer support. RPS summation uses the larger cap.

pit.contribution: Uniform over the observation CDF interval

hac.restriction: Period-specific lags must be smaller than n
hac.interpretation: Approximate pointwise intervals under weak dependence and stable mean loss difference

influence.restriction: A scored target must remain after omission

event_match.priority: Exact ISC source identifier, otherwise mutually unique time and distance candidates

isc_usgs_event_audit.scope: USGS preferred magnitude >=7 against all ISC main and supplementary records in UTC 1918–2022. Unpaired ISC qualifiers lack a unique match in the retained USGS thresholded snapshot.
